name: Milpitas Fire Explorer Program
what_you_do: Help the fire department with fire safety teaching for the public, firefighter training, and emergency planning with the Office of Emergency Services.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 18. Other rules are not stated on the page.
deadline_text: No dates are stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Call the Milpitas Fire Department at 408-586-2800 to get involved or ask questions.
notes: The page is short and gives no meeting times, requirements or application form. Call first to ask if the program is active and taking new Explorers.
